description: Paolo Pironi is a Long Island-based community leader, public servant, and award-winning professional with a strong record of leadership across civic, industry, and charitable organizations. He currently serves as Vice-Chairman of the Nassau County Open Space and Parks Advisory Committee, where he works to preserve open space and enhance public resources for residents across Nassau County.
